==English== {{wp|}} ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/nəʊ̯t/|a=RP}} * {{IPA|en|/noʊ̯t/|a=GA,CA}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-note.ogg|a=California}} * {{IPA|en|/nəʉ̯t/|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/nɐʉ̯t/|a=NZ}} * {{rhymes|en|əʊt|s=1}} * {{hyph|en|note}} ===Etymology 1=== {{etymon|en|id=remark|:inh|enm:note}} From {{inh|en|enm|note}}, from {{inh|en|ang|not}}, {{m|ang|nōt||note, mark, sign}} and {{der|en|fro|note||letter, note}}, both from {{der|en|la|nota||mark, sign, remark, note}}. ====Noun==== {{en-noun|~}} # ''A [[symbol]] or [[annotation]].'' ## A [[mark]] or [[token]] by which a thing may be known; a visible sign; a [[character]]; a distinctive mark or feature; a characteristic quality. ##* {{quote-book|en|year=1841|author=w:John Henry Newman|title=A Letter to the Right Reverend Father in God, Richard, Lord Bishop of Oxford, on Occasion of No. 90, in the Series Called ''[[w:Tracts for the Times|The Tracts for the Times]]''|location=Oxford|publisher=w:John Henry Parker|pageurl=https://books.google.com/books?id=lcsUAAAAQAAJ&pg=PA39|page=39 |passage=She [the Anglican church] has the '''Note''' of possession, the '''Note''' of freedom from party-titles ; the '''Note''' of life, a tough life and a vigorous ; she has ancient descent, unbroken continuance, agreement in doctrine with the ancient Church.}} ##* {{RQ:Allingham China Governess|chapter=20|passage=The story struck the depressingly familiar '''note''' with which true stories ring in the tried ears of experienced policemen. No one queried it. It was in the classic pattern of human weakness, mean and embarrassing and sad.}} ## A mark, or [[sign]], made to call attention, to point out something to notice, or the like; a sign, or token, proving or giving evidence. ## A brief [[remark]]; a marginal comment or explanation; hence, an [[annotation]] on a text or author; a [[comment]]; a critical, explanatory, or illustrative observation. # ''A written or printed communication or commitment.'' ## A brief piece of writing intended to assist the memory; a [[memorandum]]; a [[minute]]. ##: {{ux|en|I left him a '''note''' to remind him to take out the trash.}} ## A short informal [[letter]]; a [[billet]]. ##* {{quote-video game|en|developer=w:BioWare|title={{w|Mass Effect: Andromeda}}|genre=[[science fiction|Science Fiction]]|location=Redwood City|publisher=Electronic Arts|year=2017|system=PC|scene=Ark Hyperion|oclc=1261299044|text=Garson: Drop me a '''note''' sometime. I'd love to hear how we're doing.}} ## {{lb|en|academic}} An academic [[treatise]] (often without regard to length); a [[treatment]]; a [[discussion]] [[paper]]; (loosely) any contribution to an academic [[discourse]]. ## A diplomatic [[missive]] or written communication. ## {{senseid|en|document promising payment}} {{lb|en|finance}} A written or printed paper (or digital equivalent) acknowledging a [[debt#Noun|debt]], and promising [[payment#Noun|payment]]. ##: {{nearsyn|en|draft|bond|paper|commercial paper#Noun|IOU#Noun|letter of credit#Noun}} ##: {{ux|en|a [[promissory note|promissory '''note''']]}} ##: {{ux|en|a '''note''' of hand}} ##: {{ux|en|a negotiable '''note'''}} ##* {{quote-song|en|year=1974|author={{w|Shirley Brown}}|title={{w|Woman to Woman (Shirley Brown song)|Woman to Woman}}|album=Woman to Woman|text=The car he drives / I pay the '''note''' every month}} ## {{lb|en|obsolete}} A list of items or of charges; an account. ##* {{RQ:Shakespeare Henry 4-2|act=V|scene=i|passage=Heere is now the Smithes '''note,''' for Shooing, / And Plough-Irons.}} ## A piece of paper or polymer [[money]]; a [[banknote]]. ##: {{syn|en|bill}} ##: {{ux|en|I didn't have any coins to pay with, so I used a '''note'''.}} ##* {{quote-journal|en|journal=w:National Geographic|year=1990|month=August|volume=178|number=2|title=Yugoslavia: A House Much Divided|author=Kenneth C. Danforth|page=110 |text=Seven months ago Prime Minister Ante Marković, a Croat, attacked Yugoslavia's 2,600 percent inflation rate by making the dinar convertible to Western currencies and lopping off four zeroes. The million-dinar '''note''' shrank to a hundred dinars.}} ## {{lb|en|extension}} A small size of paper used for writing letters or notes. # {{lb|en|music}} ''A sound.'' ## {{senseid|en|Q263478}}A character, variously formed, to indicate the length of a tone, and variously placed upon the staff to indicate its pitch. ## A musical sound; a [[tone]]; an utterance; a tune; a [[beat]] of a [[drum]]. ##* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=III|lines=37–40|passage=Then feed on thoughts, that voluntarie move / Harmonious numbers ; as the wakeful Bird / Sings darkling, and in ſhadieſt Covert hid / Tunes her nocturnal '''Note'''.|year=1873}} ##* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|IV|47|Judge Short had gone to town, and Farrar was off for a three days' cruise up the lake. I was bitterly regretting I had not gone with him when the distant '''notes''' of a coach horn reached my ear, and I descried a four-in-hand winding its way up the inn road from the direction of Mohair.}} ##* {{quote-book|en|year=1922|author=w:Michael Arlen|title=[http://openlibrary.org/works/OL1519647W “Piracy”: A Romantic Chronicle of These Days]|chapter=Ep./4/2 |passage=As they turned into Hertford Street they startled a robin from the poet's head on a barren fountain, and he fled away with a cameo '''note'''.}} ##* {{RQ:Bramah Eyes of Max Carrados|passage="That's Fred," said Mrs Fitzwilliam as the iron gate beyond the little plot of beaten earth that had once been a garden gave its individual '''note'''.}} ## {{lb|en|by extension}} A [[key]] of the piano or organ. ## {{lb|en|by extension}} A call or song of a bird. ## {{lb|en|rhythm games}} An indicator to which the [[player]] must correctly time some [[input]]. # {{lb|en|perfumery}} An element of a scent, fragrance, or perfume, especially as a descriptor or category. #: {{hypo|en|top note|middle note|heart note|base note}} #* {{quote-journal|en|journal=w:National Geographic|year=1987|month=October|volume=172|number=4|title=Results of the Smell Survey|author=Avery N. Gilbert and Charles J. Wysocki|page=216 |text=Isoamyl acetate (''banana''): This familiar scent is known to most noses as the primary odor '''note''' in bananas and pears.}} # {{lb|en|uncountable}} [[observation|Observation]]; [[notice]]; [[heed]]. #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Merchant of Venice|V|i|passage=Go in ''Nerriſſa,'' / Giue order to my ſeruants, that they take / No '''note''' at all of our being abſent hence, / Nor you ''Lorenzo, Ieſſica'' nor you.}} # {{lb|en|uncountable}} [[reputation|Reputation]]; [[distinction]]. #: {{ux|en|a poet of '''note'''}} # A [[critical]] [[comment]]. #: {{ux|en|Your performance was fantastic! I have just one '''note''': you were a little flat in bars 35 and 36.}} # {{lb|en|obsolete}} [[notification|Notification]]; [[information]]; [[intelligence]]. # {{lb|en|obsolete}} Mark of [[disgrace]]. #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Lucrece|passage=That my poſteritie ſham’d with the '''note''' / Shall curſe my bones, and hold it for no ſinne, / To wiſh that I their father had not beene.}} #* {{RQ:Shakespeare Richard 2|I|i|23|2|Once more, the more to aggrauate the '''note''',
With a foule Traitors name ſtuffe I thy throte,
And wiſh (ſo pleaſe my Soueraigne) ere I moue,
What my tong ſpeaks, my right drawn ſword may proue}} =====Synonyms===== * {{sense|mark of disgrace}} {{l|en|blemish}}, {{l|en|blot}}, {{l|en|brand}}, {{l|en|reproach}}, {{l|en|stain}}, {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[annotate]]. # {{lb|en|transitive}} To set down in musical characters. # {{lb|en|transitive|law}} To record on the back of (a bill, draft, etc.) a refusal of acceptance, as the ground of a protest, which is done officially by a [[notary]]. =====Derived terms===== * {{l|en|misnote}} * {{l|en|note down}} =====Related vocabulary===== * {{l|en|nota bene}}, {{l|en|n.b.}} =====Translations===== {{trans-top|to notice with care}} * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Czech: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Estonian: * Finnish: * French: * German: * Gothic: * Greek: * Hebrew: * Latin: * Macedonian: * Malayalam: * Māori: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Slovene: * Spanish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to record in writing}} * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Czech: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Finnish: * French: * Gothic: * Greek: * Hebrew: * Italian: * Japanese: * Latvian: * Macedonian: * Malayalam: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Slovene: * Spanish: * Turkish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to denote, designate}} * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Dutch: * Finnish: * Greek: * Macedonian: * Portuguese: * Spanish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to annotate}} * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Dutch: * Finnish: * Greek: * Macedonian: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Spanish: {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-top|to set down in musical characters}} * Bulgarian: * Dutch: * Estonian: * Finnish: * Macedonian: {{trans-bottom}} {{checktrans-top}} * Ido: {{t+check|io|notar}} * Irish: {{t-check|ga|nótáil}} * Korean: {{t-check|ko|메모를 적어 두다}} {{trans-bottom}} ====See also==== * {{l|en|notable}} * {{l|en|noteless}} * {{l|en|benote}} ===Etymology 2=== {{etymid|en|use}} From {{inh|en|enm|note|t=use, usefulness, profit}}, from {{inh|en|ang|notu|t=use, enjoyment, advantage, profit, utility}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*notu}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*nutō|t=enjoyment, utilisation}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*newd-|t=to acquire, make use of}}. Cognate with {{cog|fy|not||yield, produce, crop}}, {{cog|nl|genot||enjoyment, pleasure|sc=Latn}}, {{cog|nl|nut||usefulness, utility, behoof|sc=Latn}}, {{cog|de|Nutzen||benefit, usefulness, utility|sc=Latn}}, {{cog|is|not||use|pos=noun|sc=Latn}}. Related also to {{cog|ang|notian||to enjoy, make use of, employ}}, {{cog|ang|nēotan||to use, enjoy}}, {{cog|goh|niozan||to use, enjoy}} (Modern {{cog|de|genießen||to enjoy|sc=Latn}}), Modern {{cog|de|benutzen||to use|sc=Latn}}. Related to {{l|en|nait}}. ====Alternative forms==== * {{l|en|noit}}, {{l|en|noyt}} {{qualifier|Northern England}} * {{l|en|not}} {{qualifier|Shetland}} ====Noun==== {{en-noun|-|s}}{{tlb|en|UK|_|dialectal|Northern England|Ireland|Scotland}} # {{lb|en|uncountable}} That which is [[needed]] or [[necessary]]; [[business]]; [[duty]]; [[work]]. #* '''1897''' May 27, ''Halifax Courier'', quoted in '''1903''', [[w:Joseph Wright (linguist)|Joseph Wright]], ''{{w|English Dialect Dictionary}}'', volume IV, London: {{w|Henry Frowde}}, [https://books.google.com/books?id=sIBBAQAAIAAJ&pg=PA302&lpg=PA302 page 302]: #* {{quote-book|en|year=1962|author=Arthur C. Cawley|title=Everyman, and Medieval Miracle Plays|pageurl=https://books.google.com/books?id=uqPPAAAAMAAJ|page=125 |passage=Thou canst do thy '''note'''; that have I espied.}} # Milk-giving by a cow or sow; {{lb|en|specifically}} the period following calving or farrowing, during which a cow or sow is most [[productive]] and [[useful]]. #* {{quote-book|en|year=1843|title=The Farmer's Magazine|page=384 |passage=The supply of horned cattle at this fair was great, but the business done was confined to fleshy barreners of feeding qualities and superior new-calved heifers, and those at early '''note''', with appearance of being useful; [...]}} #* {{quote-journal|en|year=1875|location=Belfast|journal=Paper |passage=For sale, a Kerry cow, five years old, at her '''note''' in May.}} #* {{quote-book|en|year=1922|author=P. MacGill|title=Lanty Hanlon|page=11 |passage=A man who drank spring water when his one cow was near '''note'''.}} # {{rfq-sense|en}} {{lb|en|by extension}} The milk given by a cow or sow during such period. =====Derived terms===== * {{l|en|notable}} {{gl|partly}} * {{l|en|noteful}} ===Further reading=== * {{R:Webster 1913}} * {{R:Century}} * {{R:New English Dictionary}} * note, A Dictionary of Archaic and Provincial Words, Volume 2, Halliwell, 1860. ===Anagrams=== * {{anagrams|en|a=enot|Teno|ETNO|toen|ento-|tone|Eton|teno-|Tone}} {{cln|en|raising verbs}} {{C|en|Communication}}
